scenarios.name: Straight Road
scenarios.description: A simple straight road from source to destination. Good for testing basic forward driving and lane keeping.

scenarios.name: T-Intersection
scenarios.description: A horizontal road with a side branch forming a T-junction. The AI must navigate past the intersection without deviating.

scenarios.name: Curved Road
scenarios.description: A road with multiple turns forming a curved path. Tests the AI's ability to handle steering through bends.
